name: Hiroto Sagawa
source:
Grouchy has been on your back since day one. His attitude swings from an A-grade employee to a temperamental toddler when you are around. Your lack of enthusiasm towards work tends to be his trigger.

He's younger than you are but has been at MegaKonbiniMart longer so he is your senpai.

For him, the Konbini is his life.


[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=38904]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
